commands:
set -eu
echo BOOTSTRAP=$(test -f /var/log/phantom-bootstrap.done && echo complete || echo incomplete)
echo K3S_UNIT
systemctl cat k3s | sed -n '1,80p'
echo CURRENT_CONTEXT
k3s kubectl config current-context
echo CLUSTER_ENDPOINT
k3s kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{.clusters[0].cluster.server}'; echo
echo NODE
k3s kubectl get nodes -o wide
echo PREDEPLOY_PODS
k3s kubectl get pods -A
